column1: # extract ratchet, cost: one row per (lang, tool, tier), 3 runs of diet_scip (resolve call+types), median wall / process-peak rss over the stated file count;

# rss is getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) of the stated pid, so a row is truthful only for the process that PRODUCED its rows; an out-of-process producer (codeql, madge, node/tsc) gets its own tool row, never sprefa's.
# check: wall +15% / rss +10% (ceilings at the worst of repeated runs); bump: RATCHET_BUMP=1 tightens a ceiling only by a 10%+ margin, RATCHET_FORCE=1 rewrites.
